doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form for HR Advisory service category. Proponents must respond to six evaluation criteria: Corporate Profile, Key Personnel and Roster, Methodology & Advisory Approach, Thought Leadership & Innovation, Relationship Management, and Value-added services. Responses limited to 12 pages excluding resumes and work samples.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D2 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – HR Advisory

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup, including profile and history, number of employees, list and description of products and services offered, range and depth of experience, core areas of expertise, and any requirements falling outside firm's scope.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty; A list of any of our requirements that fall outside your firm's scope.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing team including internal and external resources. Must include brief profiles (max half page each) for maximum of 4 individuals in dedicated relationship or coordination roles, with name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Must also describe practitioner talent available, vetting and development processes, quality standards, and resource assignment process.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Describe the practitioner talent your firm can draw on, internally or externally. Rather than listing names or submitting bios for all potential resources, tell us about your bench/roster: the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how you ensure quality and consistency when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Key Personnel and Roster

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe their approach to delivering HR advisory services and managing consulting engagements, including methodology for assessing organizational needs and defining desired outcomes, approach to developing recommendations and implementation plans, governance model and project management approach, stakeholder engagement and consultation methodologies, change management and communication approaches, and quality assurance processes.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their approach to delivering HR advisory services and managing consulting engagements. Responses should include: The methodology used to assess organizational needs and define desired outcomes; Approach to developing recommendations and implementation plans; Governance model and project management approach; Stakeholder engagement and consultation methodologies; Change management and communication approaches, where applicable; and Quality assurance processes.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Methodology & Advisory Approach

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices, including examples of innovative solutions or approaches implemented for clients, experience applying research, data analytics, benchmarking, or emerging HR practices to address client challenges, methods used to remain current with HR trends and industry developments, examples of recommendations that resulted in meaningful organizational improvements, and two (2) samples of published articles, white papers, research, frameworks, or thought leadership materials (maximum 2 pages per sample).

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices for the requirements listed in section 4.1 of the RFP. Responses should include: Examples of innovative solutions or approaches implemented for clients; Experience applying research, data analytics, benchmarking, or emerging HR practices to address client challenges; Methods used to remain current with HR trends and industry developments; Examples of recommendations that resulted in meaningful organizational improvements; and Two (2) samples of published articles, white papers, research, frameworks, or thought leadership materials developed by the Proponent (maximum limit of 2 pages per sample).
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Thought Leadership & Innovation

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe their approach to establishing, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships throughout the term of the Contract, including account management structure and governance processes, key client-facing roles and responsibilities, communication and reporting practices, approach to managing client expectations and competing priorities, escalation and issue-resolution procedures, methods used to monitor client satisfaction and obtain feedback, and an example of how the Proponent successfully responded to changing client requirements or resolved a significant client issue.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their approach to establishing, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships throughout the term of the Contract. The response should include: Account management structure and governance processes; Key client-facing roles and responsibilities; Communication and reporting practices; Approach to managing client expectations and competing priorities; Escalation and issue-resolution procedures; Methods used to monitor client satisfaction and obtain feedback; and An example of how the Proponent successfully responded to changing client requirements or resolved a significant client issue.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Relationship Management

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must describe any additional, value-added services, tools, resources, or capabilities that would enhance the Bank's ability to achieve its HR objectives. For each value-added service, proponents must explain the benefit to the Bank, how it supports HR advisory objectives, and any conditions or limitations.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe any additional, value-added services, tools, resources, or capabilities that would enhance the Bank's ability to achieve its HR objectives.  For each value-added service, explain: The benefit to the Bank; How it supports HR advisory objectives; and Any conditions or limitations
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Value-added

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents must demonstrate experience providing strategic HR advisory services to organizations of similar size, complexity, and operating environment. Must provide details for two (2) engagements completed within the last two (2) years, including client organization (or anonymized description if confidentiality applies), organizational size and sector, HR challenge or objective, scope of services provided, key deliverables, stakeholders involved, duration of the engagement, outcomes achieved and benefits realized, and client reference with contact name, title, email address, and telephone number.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate experience providing strategic HR advisory services to organizations of similar size, complexity, and operating environment. Provide details for two (2) engagements completed within the last two (2) years, including: Client organization (or anonymized description if confidentiality applies); Organizational size and sector; HR challenge or objective; Scope of services provided; Key deliverables; Stakeholders involved; Duration of the engagement; Outcomes achieved and benefits realized; and Client reference, including contact name, title, email address, and telephone number.
source_refs.source_doc: Amendment1/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response REVISED.docx

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist. doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form for Learning and Development programs and assessments procurement. Specifies submission format, page limits, and evaluation criteria structure for proponent responses across six rated categories: Corporate Profile, Key Personnel and Roster, Curriculum & Program Design Capability, Measurement Approach, Relationship Management, and Value-add, plus Relevant Experience and References.

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing their team, including internal and external resources. Brief profiles (maximum half page each, maximum 4 individuals) for those serving in dedicated relationship or coordination roles with the Bank, including name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Description of practitioner talent available, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.

evaluation_criteria.title: Key Personnel and Roster

evaluation_criteria.title: Value-add

evaluation_criteria.notes: Proponents provide two (2) examples of relevant projects completed within the last two (2) years, and accompanying references. Each example includes client organization (or anonymized description if confidentiality applies), industry and organizational size, learning and development objectives, services provided by the Proponent, target audience (e.g., executives, people leaders, individual contributors), delivery model (e.g., in-person, virtual, blended), project duration and approximate number of participants, challenges encountered and how they were addressed, measurable outcomes achieved, and client reference including contact name, title, email address, and telephone number.

requirements.description: Service Provider shall implement and maintain appropriate safeguards in accordance with current industry standards that reasonably and appropriately protect Personal Information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or loss. Safeguards shall include physical measures (secure facilities, controlled access), organizational measures (security clearances, need-to-know access), and technological measures (encryption, firewalls, strong access controls including passwords and two-factor authentication).
requirements.evidence: Implementation and maintenance of physical, organizational, and technological safeguards

source_refs.excerpt: The Service Provider shall implement and maintain appropriate safeguards in accordance with current industry standards that reasonably and appropriately protect Personal Information from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or loss. Such safeguards shall be appropriate to the sensitivity of the information and must include where applicable: Physical measures, such as secure facilities and controlled access to servers. Organizational measures, such as security clearances and limiting access on a "need-to-know" basis. Technological measures, including the use of encryption, firewalls, and strong access controls (e.g., passwords, two-factor authentication).
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-06 - Appendix G - Form of Agreement.docx

source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Stage 2. Evaluation

evaluation_criteria.notes: Bank reviews proposals to determine whether mandatory criteria in section 4.4 have been met. Failure to meet any mandatory criterion results in proposal disqualification.

source_refs.excerpt: The Bank will review the proposals to determine whether the mandatory criteria as set out in section 4.4 RFP Particulars – Mandatory criteria have been met. Failure of the proponent to meet any of the mandatory criteria will result in their proposal being disqualified.
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Mandatory criteria

evaluation_criteria.notes: Bank reviews proposals to determine whether minimum qualification requirements in Appendix C1 / C2 / C3 (as applicable) have been met. Failure to meet minimum qualification requirements results in proposal disqualification.

source_refs.excerpt: The Bank will review the proposals to determine whether the minimum qualification requirements as set out in Appendix C1 / C2/ C3 (as applicable) have been met. Failure of the proponent to meet the minimum qualification requirements will result in their proposal being disqualified.
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Minimum qualification requirements

evaluation_criteria.notes: Bank evaluates each qualified proposal based on non-price rated criteria in section 4.5 and Appendix D1/D2/D3 (as applicable). Evaluation occurs only if proposal is compliant with applicable mandatory criteria and minimum qualification requirements.

source_refs.excerpt: If compliant with the applicable mandatory criteria and minimum qualification requirements, the Bank will evaluate each qualified proposal based on the non-price rated criteria as set out in section 4.5 RFP Particulars – Rated criteria and Appendix D1/D2/D3 (as applicable).
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Rated criteria

evaluation_criteria.notes: Up to 7 top-ranked proponents for service category 1 and up to 9 top-ranked proponents for service category 3 may be invited to presentations. Presentations validate ability to deliver required services and are assessed on pass/fail basis. Proponents may not disclose pricing information. Presentations not required for service category 2.

source_refs.excerpt: As part of the evaluation process, up to seven (7) top-ranked proponents for service category 1; and up to nine (9) top-ranked proponents for service category 3 May be invited to presentations with the Evaluation Committee. These presentations will validate proponents' ability to deliver the required services and will be assessed on a pass/fail basis. Proponents may not disclose pricing information at this stage. Presentations will not be required for service category 2.
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Stage 3. Presentation/Demonstration (virtual)

evaluation_criteria.notes: Review and scoring of submitted pricing in accordance with price evaluation method in section 4.6. Price evaluation undertaken after evaluation of mandatory requirements and non-price rated criteria completed. Bank may require detailed explanation if pricing appears abnormally low.

source_refs.excerpt: Stage 4 will consist of a review and scoring of the submitted pricing of each qualified proposal in accordance with the price evaluation method set out in section 4.6 RFP Particulars – Price evaluation method. The evaluation of price will be undertaken after the evaluation of mandatory requirements and non-price rated criteria has been completed.
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Stage 4. Pricing

evaluation_criteria.notes: Scores from Stage 2, Stage 3, and Stage 4 are totalled. Highest-scoring proponents within each service category invited to negotiate. In case of tie, highest score on rated criteria determines selection. Awards made on category-by-category basis.

source_refs.excerpt: At Stage 5, the scores from Stage 2, Stage 3 and Stage 4 will be totalled and, subject to the terms of this RFP, the highest-scoring proponents within each service category will be invited to negotiate agreements based on the Form of Agreement in Appendix F, if reference checks are successful. In the event of a tie between proponents, the selected proponent will be decided by way of the highest score on the rated criteria.
source_refs.source_doc: RFP 2026-026 - Talent, Learning and Organizational Development Services.pdf

evaluation_criteria.title: Stage 5. Cumulative score

evaluation_criteria.notes: In event of tie between proponents, highest score on rated criteria determines selection.
